observable_actual: Investigated whether the failed check #3 (29.75 tok/s) is a short-completion measurement artifact. REFUTED. Linear fit latency_ms = 59.7 + 31.15*output_tokens: fixed per-call overhead is only 60 ms (prefill+network negligible); marginal decode cost 31.15 ms/token => decode-only throughput 32.10 tok/s with overhead mathematically removed. Longest completion (172 tokens) = 31.68 tok/s; longest length bucket (101-256 tok) mean 31.69 tok/s. Throughput is flat ~30-32 tok/s across all temperatures and completion lengths. Conclusion: 29.75 aggregate / ~32 decode-only is a GENUINE structural single-stream decode ceiling (GB10 SM12x no native FP4, vLLM Marlin weight-only path), matching Day-1 bench 32.03. The 40 floor is not reachable by metric reframing or by vLLM launch-flag tuning (batching lifts concurrent aggregate, not single-stream sequential decode; concurrency is out of Week-1 scope). Realistic path to >=40: MTP speculative decoding (deferred to Week 2+, D-019) or accept the structural baseline. Artifact: scripts/analyze_day2_throughput.py.
observable_expected: determine whether 29.75 tok/s is genuine or a measurement artifact
